jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.summary: This Business Analyst role combines data analysis and hands-on technical work to translate stakeholder needs into actionable technical requirements and reliable data processes. The position improves campaign and operational performance through reporting KPI tracking SQL based validation and API integrations.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu We are seeking a motivated and analytically minded Business Analyst to join our team and support our US-based partner company. Our partner company is a business process outsourcing company delivering AI-governed contact center, sales, and marketing services for regulated industries. As a Business Analyst, you will work closely with the Data Performance and Lead Generation teams. As part of your collaboration with the Data Performance team, you will support data analysis, performance measurement, data quality and validation, reporting, requirements definition, and the translation of business needs into actionable technical requirements. jobs.title: Computer Vision Algorithms Engineer - Edge AI
jobs.summary: Senior engineer responsible for designing and delivering privacy preserving occupancy sensing models that meet strict accuracy latency memory and power constraints on edge devices. The role focuses on translating research into reliable production systems through robust data training evaluation and deployment pipelines while collaborating with embedded hardware QA and product teams.
jobs.details: O poslodavcu About the role Trego is looking for an experienced Computer Vision Algorithms Engineer to take ownership of computer vision models for smart occupancy-sensing applications. You will design, train, evaluate, optimize, and deploy models for privacy-preserving occupancy sensors. This is a hands-on role combining applied research with production engineering, with a strong focus on reliable performance on resource-constrained edge devices. What you will do Develop and maintain models for people detection, counting, and tracking, combining deep learning with classical computer vision where appropriate. Build reproducible data, training, evaluation, and model-release pipelines. Define datasets, annotation requirements, and evaluation protocols that reflect real deployment conditions. Analyze field data and model failures to improve accuracy and overall product performance. Optimize and deploy models within accuracy, latency, memory, compute, and power constraints. Collaborate with embedded software, hardware, QA, product, and customer-facing teams on integration, validation, and issue investigation. Reference: Dk3wByNNkO2284icSkLt4XLqs8vbDXGGYcQaMwlz1g079X1MinFUkhx4GMfa8I_- What you bring At least 5 years of industry experience in computer vision or deep learning, including object detection and tracking. Strong proficiency in Python and C++, together with NumPy, OpenCV, and PyTorch or TensorFlow. Demonstrated experience taking computer vision models from research into production. Hands-on experience optimizing neural networks for constrained edge hardware, including INT8 quantization and performance profiling. A strong understanding of model evaluation, dataset quality, overfitting, distribution shift, and failure analysis. An M.Sc. in Computer Science or Electrical Engineering, with a specialization in computer vision. The ability to work independently and communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Professional working proficiency in English. Additional advantages Experience with YOLO models and model-conversion tools such as ONNX or TensorFlow Lite. Experience with embedded Linux, camera pipelines, real-time systems, or NPU and DSP toolchains. Experience with low-resolution or wide-angle imagery, people counting, or occupancy analytics. Experience with MLOps. Experience using AI-assisted development tools. Trego Ltd Trego (www.trego-usa.com) is a high-end provider of turn-key solutions and RT Embedded SW. Our Main Expertise are Embedded Linux, Video-based products, and Semiconductors. Trego's Engineers are exposed to diverse state-of-the-art technologies (Architectures, tools, environments etc.). They perform mostly proper R&D tasks and hardly any maintenance. We are a small group of experts, working in a flexible, tolerant and purely professional atmosphere. jobs.details: O poslodavcu ABOUT US Stellar Advisory is an international consultancy and software company specialising in real estate technology and a leading Yardi implementation partner in the Netherlands. We support some of the largest real estate owners and asset managers in the Netherlands and across Europe, with several of our clients managing portfolios exceeding 1,000,000 m². ABOUT THE ROLE Stellar Advisory supports real estate organisations with Yardi implementations, system optimisation, data migration, business intelligence and ongoing support. Our teams operate from Amsterdam and Novi Sad. We are looking for a Junior Yardi Consultant who is interested in ERP systems and wants to develop into a Yardi specialist. Help prepare system documentation and end-user training materials. Support go-live preparation and implementation activities. TECH STACK Amazon Web Services — AWS je naš primarni cloud provajder. Kubernetes — Amazon EKS koristimo za deployment i upravljanje aplikacijama i servisima u kontejnerskom okruženju. Terraform — Za Infrastructure as Code (IaC) koristimo Terraform. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack — Prometheus koristimo za prikupljanje metrika i monitoring, Grafanu za vizualizaciju podataka, a ELK Stack za logovanje. Agentic Coding alati — Claude Code i slični AI alati za podršku razvoju redovan su deo našeg načina rada. Enterprise alati za razvoj i saradnju — GitLab koristimo za source control i CI/CD pipeline-ove, Jira za praćenje zadataka, Confluence za dokumentaciju, a Slack za internu komunikaciju. ODLIČNO ĆEŠ SE UKLOPITI AKO... Imaš iskustva sa tehnologijama koje koristimo — Ne očekujemo da poznaješ baš svaki alat iz našeg tech stack-a, ali očekujemo dobro razumevanje sistemske i infrastrukturne arhitekture. Poželjno je i iskustvo u radu sa vodećim cloud provajderima. Imaš najmanje 8 godina iskustva — Imaš minimum osam godina relevantnog radnog iskustva na sličnoj poziciji, kao Systems Engineer ili DevOps Engineer. Imaš iskustva sa DevOps alatima — Radio si sa alatima koji pokrivaju različite faze DevOps životnog ciklusa, od provisioninga i izgradnje infrastrukture, do monitoringa i upravljanja produkcionim sistemima. Poznaješ programiranje i skriptovanje — Imaš iskustva u pisanju skripti za automatizaciju ponavljajućih zadataka, razumeš agilne prakse razvoja softvera i odlično poznaješ Git. Jasna komunikacija i timski duh — Samostalno komuniciraš na engleskom jeziku (pisano i usmeno), empatičan si u radu sa kolegama i odlično se snalaziš u timskom okruženju. jobs.details: Tech Lead Morffeus Tech Lead Morffeus Insby Odgovara na prijave Beograd 01.10.2026. Docker PostgreSQL CMS Flutter senior O proizvodu Morffeus (morffeus.com) je operativni sistem svake kompanije. Jedna platforma na kojoj kompanija obavlja ceo posao: prodaju, marketing, podršku, sadržaj, analitiku i operacije. Na njoj rade digitalni zaposleni — AI kolege koje firma zapošljava umesto ljudi, za svaku ulogu, po fiksnoj mesečnoj ceni kao i svakog drugog člana tima. Ne pravimo alat za jedan sektor. Pravimo firmu koja radi sama. Platforma je u produkciji, klijenti plaćaju, digitalni zaposleni već rade. Sledeća faza je da oni postanu ceo proizvod. Tražimo osobu koja će voditi tehnički tim kroz tu fazu. Šta ćeš raditi Voditi razvoj Morffeus platforme sa timom od dvoje developera. Ovo je hands-on uloga: oko 70% vremena pišeš kod, ostatak vodiš tim i sistem. Preuzeti vlasništvo nad produkcijom: deploy, monitoring, incidenti, troškovi infrastrukture. Raditi code review i otključavati kolege na sva tri steka: Elixir/Phoenix (backend, digitalni zaposleni, analitika), Flutter (mobilne aplikacije) i Next.js (CMS i web). Dokumentovati sistem tako da znanje bude u timu, ne u glavama. Ovo je prva liderska pozicija za nekoga ko je spreman za taj korak. Ne tražimo gotovog menadžera. Tražimo jakog seniora koji hoće da postane tech lead na pravom proizvodu. Šta tražimo 5 do 8 godina profesionalnog iskustva. Elixir i Phoenix u produkciji. Najveći deo platforme je na BEAM-u, pa je ovo stek u kojem očekujemo najviše sigurnosti. Ako dolaziš iz drugog jakog backend steka i imaš iskustvo sa Elixirom, javi se. Flutter na radnom nivou: objavio si aplikaciju, vodio release, napravio bar jedan native plugin. Next.js na radnom nivou: napravio si i deployovao produkcionu aplikaciju sa SSR-om i API slojem. PostgreSQL, Docker, CI/CD. Bio si na dežurstvu za nešto što si sam napravio. Mentorisao si bar jednu ili dve osobe. Jasno pišeš i govoriš na srpskom i engleskom. Možeš da sedneš sa klijentom. Ozbiljno te zanimaju LLM alati i već si nešto napravio sa njima. Iskustvo sa agentima u produkciji je plus, ne uslov. Najverovatnije dolaziš iz manje agencije ili product studija gde si morao da radiš sve. To je tačno profil koji tražimo. Šta nam nije potrebno Da si ekspert u sva tri steka. Niko nije. Očekujemo dubinu u Elixiru i poštenu radnu kompetenciju u ostala dva. Iskustvo iz velikih korporacija sa platformskim timovima koji rade infrastrukturu za tebe. Menadžer koji je prestao da piše kod. Šta nudimo Pisani plan rasta nakon dvanaest meseci, vezan za rast prihoda proizvoda, ne za dobru volju. Mogućnost udela u firmi za osobu koja vodi razvoj proizvoda. O modelu razgovaramo tokom procesa. Rad iz kancelarije u Beogradu, uz tim koji sedi zajedno i odlučuje na licu mesta. Mali tim, kratke odluke, direktan pristup osnivaču. Nema slojeva. Proizvod koji ima ime, sajt i klijente. Ne gradiš nešto što se ne vidi. Kako izgleda proces Kratak razgovor (30 min) — ko si, šta si gradio/la, šta hoćeš dalje. Tehnički deo (90 min) — tri kratka code review-a na našem pravom kodu: jedan merge request iz Elixir backenda, jedan iz Flutter aplikacije i jedna Next.js komponenta. Ne tražimo savršenstvo u sva tri. Tražimo sigurnost u jednom i pošten, kompetentan komentar u ostala dva. Vežba iz dizajna sistema (60 min) — projektuješ jedan realan deo sistema digitalnih zaposlenih sa nama na tabli. Konkuriši Link je kopiran. Preporuke se učitavaju...
